title: The Rainmaker’s Apron
description: On First Rain Day, the family hangs the striped apron across the courtyard. Its embroidered clouds begin to drip, and the youngest rainmaker raises the first bowl.
alt: A child and two women lift a turquoise bowl under a giant blue-striped apron. Rain falls from its embroidered clouds into pottery bowls in a sunlit courtyard.
pairing: An imagined first-rain holiday × an apron with rainmaking embroidery
